summary:
Implementation Plan for Academic Community in DiplomaMate:
- Schema extensions for communities, memberships, messages, attachments, and reports in academic-store.json
- Server-side academic eligibility enforcement and role authorization (Student, Class Captain, Teacher, Admin)
- Community directory, search, message threads, file sharing (PDF, docs, small videos), pinning, per-community mute
- New student onboarding community recommendations
- Moderation tools and Admin abuse control endpoints
- End-to-end verification and testing suite
